goal_title: Start the recursive research loop in the separation-family halls
label_meaning: Companion experiment records under doc/book/experiments/ for halls hosting the 2026-10-13 separation-family artifacts.
why: Palle's 2026-10-14 direction: start the loop for some of the sequences. The loop is the recursive research method of doc/book/RECURSIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md - tutorial and final initiate experiments, whose consequences return to revise either text or the apparatus. Five halls across the final-arc sequences (postfoundationscrisis, qfeplaboratory, foundationscrisis, criticalalgorithms, advancedlaboratory, artmathematics) received separation-family artifacts on 2026-10-13; each hall's existing texts can now initiate a bounded experiment against a built apparatus.
specification: doc/book/RECURSIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md and doc/book/experiments/README.md define the record contract. Each new record starts at status=proposed: sources bound by archived snapshot and SHA-256 (no commit inferred for dirty working-tree files), competing interpretations declared, an invented arithmetic fixture calculated from code constants, observations explicitly empty, both text reviews pending, next experiment awaiting observations.
decision_record: Record selection and all executions remain Palle's call. The proposed records bind questions; they claim no runs.
implementation_authorization: Proposed records and validator scoping only. No hall text revised, no map changed, no sweep run.
prerequisites: doc/book/experiments/random-definition/seed-bench-001 pilot (scripted cycle complete, human stages open)

tasks.title: Review the five proposed companion records and select which runs first
tasks.spec: Read each experiment.json and proposition.md under doc/book/experiments/{advanced-laboratory,qfep-edge-of-chaos,escher-impossible,algorithmic-bias,situated-computation}/. Confirm the bound excerpts are the passages that should initiate, and that the competing interpretations are worth separating. Select one record for the first scoped cycle, or revise/reject a binding. A rejected binding is recorded, not deleted.
tasks.output: A selection note in the chosen record's proposition.md or a forum answer; unchosen records stay proposed.
tasks.verification: Human review; no runtime evidence required.
tasks.acceptance: One record named first, with the reason recorded.

tasks.title: Scope the executed-record contract into the validator
tasks.spec: doc/book/experiments/validate_experiments.py currently refuses executed status for non-pilot records. Before the first non-pilot cycle completes, define its run-receipt, observation and review checks against that record's own contract (mirroring the pilot's receipt/manifest/snapshot discipline, parameterized instead of hard-coded). Pilot checks stay byte-identical.
tasks.blocked_reason: Which record runs first decides which contract is scoped in.
tasks.verification: python -X utf8 doc/book/experiments/validate_experiments.py exits 0 with the pilot and all proposed records.
tasks.acceptance: A deliberately faulty executed record (invented run receipt) is rejected.

tasks.title: Execute the first scoped cycle on the selected record
tasks.spec: Bind the actual scene and build identity, run the artifact's existing probe under this record's identity with retained receipts and source manifests (the pilot's runtime/ pattern), gate settle verdicts at 60 and 90 Hz, and record scoped observations with limits. The 2026-10-13 build-campaign measurements are prior method evidence, not observations of this record; the cycle re-establishes its own baseline. No DNA sweep is part of this task.
tasks.blocked_reason: Selection and validator scoping come first.
tasks.output: Run receipts, observations.md entries, experiment.json moved to in_progress.
tasks.verification: Validator green; receipts hash-match; both tick rates gated.
tasks.acceptance: A baseline, one intervention, a comparison and a retained result are documented; an inconclusive result is admissible.

tasks.title: Review tutorial and final independently after evidence
tasks.spec: After separation_research.003, review the hall's tutorial.md and final.md separately: revise, retain with reasons, or keep an open question. Record evidence links and any successor source version. Hall text follows the current map - verify placements before revising (Core Rule, CLAUDE.md).
tasks.output: text_reviews filled in experiment.json; revision.md updated.
tasks.verification: Validator green; decisions reference observation ids.
tasks.acceptance: Both reviews recorded; neither text forced to change.

tasks.title: Decide the next experiment from what actually happened
tasks.spec: Record continue, redirect, defer or stop for the executed record, naming the observation or reconstruction difficulty behind the decision. The remaining four proposed records are candidates, not a queue; evidence may also point somewhere none of them name.
tasks.acceptance: The decision cites observation ids; a predetermined choice cannot stand in for it.

success_criteria: Five proposed records validate against the generic contract with the pilot untouched.
The first non-pilot cycle, when Palle selects it, can run without inventing evidence or loosening the pilot's checks.
Each hall's texts remain unrevised until a review with evidence asks for it.
